name: Agent-MQ
description: agent-mq is a message queue that enables AI coding agents to communicate with each other across sessions and machines. Agents can send messages, delegate tasks, and coordinate work — all through MCP tools. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, and any MCP-compatible tool. UUID-based authentication with per-user data isolation. Self-hostable with Docker.
